hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market YES/NO pools implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) dynamic fees. Each swap requires a backend-signed sigma parameter; fees are computed via e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]−1 and extracted from the collateral token via beforeSwap delta, then routed to a YieldDistributor for share holders. Also tracks LP positions and updates market prices after each pool operation.
